language_shifts.shift: Lithium market described as 'continues to accelerate' - highest-confidence forward-looking language in the series
'continues to accelerate' downgraded to 'remains strong' - first sign of hedging, coinciding with 14% revenue decline YoY
Added caveat 'while managing the high cost of expanding capacity' alongside lithium market positivity - acknowledges execution challenge for first time
New CEO introduces corporate purpose statement 'making the world safe and sustainable by powering the potential of people' - aspirational mission language replaces operational specificity
End-market list drops 'custom chemistry services' consistent with FCS divestiture completion; forward-looking risk factors list expanded to include acquisition/divestiture transaction risks
Disclosure of $504.5M after-tax arbitration loss (Huntsman matter from legacy Rockwood acquisition) not prefigured in prior quarter outlooks; defensive/explanatory tone introduced

red_flags: Arbitration ruling in Q3 2021 resulted in $504.5M after-tax loss ($(3.36) diluted EPS impact) - not disclosed or foreshadowed in any prior quarter outlook section
Credit covenant modified in May 2020 to expand net debt/EBITDA tolerance to 4.5x through Sept 2021 - signals balance sheet stress undisclosed in Q1 2020 outlook framing
Silver Peak capacity doubling commitment ($30-50M investment, target 2025) announced Q1 2021 with no subsequent progress confirmation in Q5 or Q6 filings reviewed
Lithium market tone progression from 'accelerates' to 'remains strong' to 'managing high cost of expanding capacity' shows systematic hedging despite nominally positive framing each quarter

notable_shifts.observation: Lithium battery and energy storage market described with peak confidence: 'continues to accelerate, providing the opportunity to continue to develop high quality and innovative products' - most optimistic framing in the series
'continues to accelerate' replaced by 'remains strong' - subtle but deliberate tonal downgrade coinciding with a 14% YoY revenue decline; no explicit acknowledgment of the shift
Qualifying phrase 'while managing the high cost of expanding capacity' inserted into lithium market discussion for the first time - acknowledges margin pressure in growth business
New CEO introduces aspirational purpose statement ('making the world safe and sustainable by powering the potential of people'); forward-looking risk factor list unchanged from prior quarters

Forward-looking risk factors section expanded with new hedging categories: 'product development; future acquisition and divestiture transactions; expected benefits from proposed transactions; timing of active and proposed projects' - broader disclaimer scope signals increased M&A activity complexity

$(3.36) diluted loss per share from $504.5M Huntsman arbitration ruling disclosed without prior quarters having mentioned any material litigation risk; management narrative pivots to Tianyuan acquisition as growth signal
